entries.853210cb3dde75af: Under the purpose “Protecting lives, supporting the future,” it is advancing a medium-term management plan with a five-year implementation period from the fiscal year ended March 2025 to the fiscal year ending March 2029. In addition to strengthening its business foundation through creating synergies among group companies, it promotes management that emphasizes profitability and capital efficiency, aiming for sustainable growth and enhancement of corporate value.
